title: Starting a channel focused on algo trading + F&O education for Indian markets, would love feedback!
author: Hanulytics
selftext:
Hey everyone,



We're launching a YouTube channel called [Hanulytics](https://www.youtube.com/@Hanulytics). The idea came from watching how much of the "trading content" out there is either tip-selling or hype with zero process behind it.

What we're planning to cover:

Futures & Options concepts, explained properly (not "guaranteed profit" nonsense)

Indian market news and events, and how they actually affect price

Structured education for people who want to understand the why

Podcasts and open discussions with traders, quants, and builders

Our perspective as an algo trading platform, so a lot of data-driven thinking



No calls, no "join my paid group" energy, just trying to build something genuinely useful.



If you trade Indian F&O or work with algos, what topics would you actually want covered? Open to criticism too.
